title: Mean time to detect — ransomware (MTTD)
summary: Time between the earliest endpoint-telemetry evidence of a ransomware precursor (shadow-copy deletion, backup-tool abuse, mass file rename) and the moment the ransomware_containment playbook ingests it via its triage step. Lower is better. Anchored on ENISA threat-landscape guidance for ransomware-class signals and on the NIS2 Article 21 risk-management baseline.

target.rationale: ENISA good-practice baseline: ransomware encryption windows are measured in minutes; ingest latency must be tighter.

measurement.formula: p95( playbook.triage_signal.started_at - telemetry.process_activity.time ) over confirmed ransomware events in window.

inputs.name: first_event
inputs.description: earliest OCSF Process Activity event carrying the ransomware precursor

inputs.name: triage_started
inputs.description: start time of the playbook's triage-signal step

external_refs.name: NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555, Article 21 — cybersecurity risk-management measures
